documents.title: Implicit midpoint oscillator work and energy balance
documents.summary: Exact rational work-energy identity for a damped oscillator step.
assumptions: Rational variables; nondimensional unit mass; both midpoint step equations hold.
limitations: Author-operated formal example; no measurements, convergence guarantee or independent certificate.

documents.title: Forward Euler oscillator energy growth
documents.summary: The explicit forward Euler update multiplies twice the oscillator energy by one plus the squared time step.
assumptions: Rational position, velocity and time step; unit stiffness.
limitations: Energy growth identity, not a conservation theorem or experimental result.

documents.title: Zero damping midpoint energy conservation
documents.summary: Reuse of the general midpoint balance to prove conservation of oscillator energy in an undamped step.
assumptions: Zero damping; rational parameters; both undamped midpoint equations hold.
limitations: Does not assert energy conservation with positive damping; author-operated reuse, not independent research.

documents.title: Natural number addition by zero
documents.summary: A minimal exact Lean theorem about adding zero to a natural number.
limitations: Arithmetic exporter example; no physical model or discovery claim.

documents.title: Rejected false Euler conservation fixture
documents.summary: A deliberately false concrete Euler energy equality; the Lean self-test expects proof failure.
assumptions: Unit position and step; initially zero velocity.
limitations: This attempted proof is rejected. It is never a verified conservation claim.

documents.title: Exact fractional oscillator trajectory checks
documents.summary: Numerical model tests for dissipation, reversibility and forward Euler counterexamples using exact fractions.
assumptions: Nonnegative step, stiffness and damping in the dissipation grid.
limitations: Finite trajectories and test cases do not prove a universal theorem or establish experimental validity.

documents.title: Evidence requirements for connections between physical models
documents.summary: Derivations, symmetry, equivalences, controlled limits and empirical disagreements need explicitly scoped evidence.
assumptions: Proposed research acceptance profiles and documented physical assumptions.
limitations: Design guidance; it supplies no proof of a particular equivalence or empirical confirmation.

documents.title: Independent research reuse evaluation
documents.summary: A proposed comparison of ordinary research, repository reuse and xLemma using held-out tasks and full cost accounting.
assumptions: Preregistered tasks and independent downstream researchers are required.
limitations: A proposed evaluation; no measured scientific acceleration or independent participant result.

documents.title: Funded research allocation and budget conservation
documents.summary: An offline economic pilot with protected funding categories and adversarial duplicate and appeal scenarios.
assumptions: Settled funding and published eligibility rules; synthetic pilot inputs.
limitations: Conservation of money is not conservation of physical energy or proof of scientific novelty.
